(I)--a son of Kambalabarhis; father of रुक्मेषु and four other sons. Learned and wealthy; con- quered the whole earth by killing of कवचिनस् (soldiers in armour) with sharp arms and performed अश्वमेध; Ruk- मेषु became king and another पृथुरुक्म helped him; two other sons, Parigha and Hari were appointed over Videha; banished by them the other son ज्यामघ performed penance.
2: M. ४४. २५-30; Va. ९५. २५-26.
^1 Br. III. ७०. २६-9.
--the lord of stars, trees, plants, etc.

--in गया where शन्कर sported with पार्वती and to which मरीचि went to gather fruits and flowers; interrupted in his enjoyment शिव cursed him, but the latter praised him in prayer; शिव promised him release from the curse if he would visit गया; the blackman became changed into white colour. वा. ११२. ३५-39. [page३-084+ ३४]
--see प्रविष्ट Agni; son of अर्काग्नि. Br. II. १२. ४३; वा. २९. ४०.
--a daughter of Rukmi, and wife of Pra- dyumna; mother of Aniruddha. भा. X. ६१. १८ and २३ [9]; Vi. IV. १५. ३८-9.

--first son of the Vidarbha king, भीष्मक; brother of रुक्मिणी, and enemy of कृष्ण; capital भोजकट; wanted to give his sister रुक्मिणी to Caidya, though his brothers were for कृष्ण.
1: भा. X. ५२. २२; ६०. १८; Vi. V. २८. 9; Br. IV. २९. १२२.
Followed कृष्ण running with his sister and near the नर्मदा fought with him. On an appeal from रुक्मिणी to spare his life, Rukmi was put to shame by the removal of his locks of hair and moustache and tied to his chariot; could not reconcile himself with कृष्ण's action and resolved to kill कृष्ण and then enter कुण्डिन. Released by बलराम, he built and lived in भोजकट with- out going back to कुण्डिन.
2: भा. X. ५२. २५; ५३. 2; ५४. १८-36, ५२; Vi. V. २६ (whole).
Was met by शाल्व at कुण्डिन; was stationed by जरासन्ध at the western gate of मथुरा and on the eastern side during the siege of

: भा. X. ७६. 2 [9]; ७८ [5]; ५०. ११ [5]; ५२. ११ [6].
Gave his daughter to Pradyumna in marriage to please his sister, but continued to hate कृष्ण; prayed to शिव who gave him a bow saying that it would not harm Hari; went back to [page३-085+ ३८] भोजकट, afraid of meeting कृष्ण.
4: Ib. X. ६१. १९-23 [1-7]; Vi. V. २८. 6.
Gave his grand- daughter to Aniruddha in marriage. When he invited राम for a game of dice on the occasion, he played falsely and insulted बलराम (s.v.) as a cowherd and forester at which he was struck dead. कृष्ण passed no comments on his death out of consideration for his brother and रुक्मिणी.
5: भा. X. ६१. २५-39;

(I)--a daughter of भीष्मक and known as वैदर्भी. Married to कृष्ण according to गान्धर्व? (राक्षस) form;
1: भा.

. १४४; V. २६ (whole).
when she came to know of the proposal of her eldest brother Rukmi (s.v.) to give her in marriage to Caidya, she sent a letter through a ब्राह्मण to कृष्ण show- ing her unflinching devotion to him and requesting that she might be carried off when she would be on her way to the देवी temple on the day prior to the wedding as was the custom. That day she had her bath and decked herself with two clothes and many jewels. Her anxiety at not having heard from कृष्ण, when the ब्राह्मण came to tell her that कृष्ण would do the needful. Citizens were also for her marriage with कृष्ण. Well guarded and accom- panied by singing and dancing, रुक्मिणी entered the temple and prayed for कृष्ण's hand. After worshipping इन्द्राणी nearby she returned when कृष्ण carried her away in his chariot. Seeing the party of Caidya pursuing him, रुक्मिणी became nervous when कृष्ण consoled her. When Caidya was about to be killed by कृष्ण she appealed to the Lord to spare him; राम consoled her. The regular marriage and festivities followed.
2: भा. X. Chh. ५२-54.
Mother of ११ sons and a daughter; gave birth to Pradyumna who was stolen by शम्बर and thrown into the sea. Recovered and taken back by माया- वती alias रती; रुक्मिणी remembered her lost son and won- dered at his exact resemblance. At that time came कृष्ण and नारद who explained the history of Pradyumna to [page३-086+ ३६] her great joy;
3: Ib.

; ३०. ३५; ३२. 1.
was the chief queen of कृष्ण and more attached; would not like to be away from कृष्ण; when she was once fanning him gently कृष्ण cut a joke that his status was poor and that she could even then get married to a rich prince and enjoy luxuries. रुक्मिणी wept in deep distress and spoke words reiterating her full devotion to him. कृष्ण consoled her assuring her of his loyalty.
4: भा. X. ६० (whole) ; ७०. 3; ९०. ३०.
Grave concern at कृष्ण not returning from the cave of जाम्बवन् for a long time. Her daughter चारुमती was married to the son of कृतवर्मन्.
5: Ib. X. ५६. ३४; ६१. २४.
Attended the marriage of Aniruddha and रोचना at भोजकट; out of regard for her and बलराम, कृष्ण said nothing on Rukmi's death.
6: Ib. X. ६१. २६-39.
Explained to Drau- पदी how she became married to कृष्ण; welcomed to हास्ति- napura by कुन्ती and द्रौपदी; served Kucela, a friend and classmate of कृष्ण.
7: Ib. X. ७१. ४२; ७६. 2; ८०. २३; ८३. 8.
Entered fire on कृष्ण's decease;
8: Ib. XI. ३१. २०. Vi. V. ३
--in front of the वट in गया. वा. १०८. ५७.

(II)--(ब्रह्मेषु) son of Rucaka (Rukma- kavaca ब्र्। प्। and म्। प्।) and brother of पृथुरुक्म; suc- ceeded his father with पृथुरुक्म as his lieutenant. भा. IX. २३. ३५; Br. III. ७०. २९; M. ४४, २८-9; वा. ९५. २८-9. [page३-087+ ३३]
